// Root-only fixed forward451 migration; no resolve/reset/seed or direct ledger DML.
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {readFileSync,writeFileSync,readdirSync,existsSync} from 'node:fs';
import {createRequire} from 'node:module';
import {execFileSync,spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {checkServerIdentity} from 'node:tls';
// BEGIN FIXED RDS TLS OPTIONS (exercised verbatim by owned-loopback tests).
const RDS_CA_SHA256='b1711d12bae51838581281e23b6cb97b1074016873b4dafc80ed14002462dd77';
const RDS_CA_PEM=Buffer.from('','base64').toString('utf8');
function rdsTlsOptions(connectionString){
  assert.equal(createHash('sha256').update(RDS_CA_PEM).digest('hex'),RDS_CA_SHA256);
  const databaseUrl=new URL(connectionString);
  assert.equal(databaseUrl.protocol,'postgresql:');
  assert.match(databaseUrl.hostname,/^[a-z0-9.-]+\.us-east-1\.rds\.amazonaws\.com$/u);
  assert.equal(databaseUrl.searchParams.get('sslmode'),'require');
  assert.equal(databaseUrl.searchParams.getAll('sslmode').length,1);
  for(const name of databaseUrl.searchParams.keys())assert.ok(['schema','sslmode','connection_limit'].includes(name));
  // pg-connection-string sslmode would replace the explicit ssl object.
  databaseUrl.searchParams.delete('sslmode');
  return {connectionString:databaseUrl.toString(),ssl:{ca:RDS_CA_PEM,rejectUnauthorized:true,
    servername:databaseUrl.hostname,
    checkServerIdentity:(_hostname,certificate)=>checkServerIdentity(databaseUrl.hostname,certificate)}};
}
// END FIXED RDS TLS OPTIONS

const NAME='20281006010000_mail_threads_owned_connection_covering';
const PRIOR_NAME='20281005010000_memory_version_candidate_source_kinds';
const PRIOR_SHA='a8be392c1de78038b1fc584e5a2293183d736f7732890737402833c864e2c6ce';
const INDEX='mail_threads_tenant_connection_id_cover_idx';
const CHECKS=['memory_candidate_source_kind_chk','memory_candidate_version_payload_check'];
const HASH=/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/u,SHA=/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/u;
const canonical=v=>v instanceof Date?JSON.stringify(v.toISOString()):v===null||typeof v!=='object'?JSON.stringify(v):Array.isArray(v)?`[${v.map(canonical).join(',')}]`:`{${Object.keys(v).sort().map(k=>JSON.stringify(k)+':'+canonical(v[k])).join(',')}}`;
export const hash=bytes=>createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
const stableHash=value=>hash(canonical(value));
const PREFIX='MERI_FORWARD451_RECEIPT ';
let currentGuard='INPUT';
export function validateInput(value){
 assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(value).sort(),['baseline','checkSha256','manifestSha256','migrationSha256','sourceSha','version']);
 assert.equal(value.version,1);assert.match(value.sourceSha,SHA);
 for(const name of ['manifestSha256','migrationSha256'])assert.match(value[name],HASH);
 assert.equal(value.migrationSha256,'de0d73ca70787ceeb1d133aa539f2d291e6589bebb386210c7d4f3c8a7477915');
 assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(value.checkSha256).sort(),CHECKS);for(const name of CHECKS)assert.match(value.checkSha256[name],HASH);
 assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(value.baseline).sort(),['activeFinished','apiHistorySha256','fullLedgerSha256','rolledBack','total']);
 assert.equal(value.baseline.total,606);assert.equal(value.baseline.activeFinished,506);assert.equal(value.baseline.rolledBack,100);
 assert.match(value.baseline.fullLedgerSha256,HASH);assert.match(value.baseline.apiHistorySha256,HASH);
 return value;
}
export const LEDGER_SQL=`SELECT id,migration_name,checksum,started_at::text AS started_at,finished_at::text AS finished_at,rolled_back_at::text AS rolled_back_at,applied_steps_count
 FROM public._prisma_migrations ORDER BY migration_name,id`;
export const CHECK_SQL=`SELECT conname AS name,convalidated AS validated,pg_get_constraintdef(oid) AS definition
 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.memory_candidate'::regclass
 AND conname IN ('memory_candidate_source_kind_chk','memory_candidate_version_payload_check') ORDER BY conname`;
export const LOCK_SQL=`SELECT count(*)::int AS count FROM pg_locks
 WHERE pid<>pg_backend_pid() AND relation IN ('public.mail_threads'::regclass,'public._prisma_migrations'::regclass)
 AND database=(SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database())
 AND mode IN ('RowExclusiveLock','ShareUpdateExclusiveLock','ShareLock','ShareRowExclusiveLock','ExclusiveLock','AccessExclusiveLock')`;
export const INDEX_SQL=`SELECT c.relname AS name,n.nspname AS schema,t.relname AS table_name,am.amname AS method,
 i.indisunique AS is_unique,i.indisprimary AS is_primary,i.indisvalid AS is_valid,i.indisready AS is_ready,
 i.indnkeyatts::int AS key_count,i.indnatts::int AS total_count,i.indpred IS NULL AS no_predicate,i.indexprs IS NULL AS no_expression,
 ARRAY(SELECT a.attname::text FROM unnest(i.indkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(attnum,ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=i.indrelid AND a.attnum=k.attnum ORDER BY k.ord) AS columns,
 pg_get_indexdef(c.oid) AS definition
 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_index i ON i.indexrelid=c.oid
 JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid=i.indrelid JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid=c.relam
 WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname='mail_threads_tenant_connection_id_cover_idx'`;
export function checkIndex(rows,after){
 assert.equal(rows.length,after?1:0);if(!after)return {present:false};
 const row=rows[0];assert.equal(row.name,INDEX);assert.equal(row.schema,'public');assert.equal(row.table_name,'mail_threads');assert.equal(row.method,'btree');
 assert.equal(row.is_unique,false);assert.equal(row.is_primary,false);
 for(const key of ['is_valid','is_ready','no_predicate','no_expression'])assert.equal(row[key],true);
 assert.equal(row.key_count,3);assert.equal(row.total_count,4);assert.deepEqual(row.columns,['tenant_id','connection_id','id','client_id']);
 assert.equal(hash(row.definition),'7097d64ec1650dfa8e004e89a1e2f6f267cb7924e869993bb44fb235e9716c9e');
 return {present:true,definitionSha256:hash(row.definition),method:row.method,keyColumns:row.columns.slice(0,3),includeColumns:row.columns.slice(3),unique:false,valid:true,ready:true,noPredicate:true,noExpression:true};
}
export function checkEstablishedLedger(rows,manifest,input,after){
 assert.equal(manifest.length,451);assert.equal(manifest.at(-1).name,NAME);assert.equal(manifest.at(-2).name,PRIOR_NAME);assert.equal(manifest.at(-2).sha256,PRIOR_SHA);
 const legacy=rows.filter(r=>![NAME,PRIOR_NAME].includes(r.migration_name)),prior=rows.filter(r=>r.migration_name===PRIOR_NAME),added=rows.filter(r=>r.migration_name===NAME);
 assert.equal(rows.length,607+(after?1:0));assert.equal(added.length,after?1:0);assert.equal(prior.length,1);
 assert.equal(new Set(rows.map(r=>r.id)).size,rows.length);assert.ok(rows.every(r=>typeof r.id==='string'&&r.id.length>0));
 assert.equal(stableHash(legacy),input.baseline.fullLedgerSha256);assert.equal(legacy.length,606);
 assert.equal(legacy.filter(r=>r.finished_at!==null&&r.rolled_back_at===null).length,506);assert.equal(legacy.filter(r=>r.rolled_back_at!==null).length,100);
 assert.equal(rows.filter(r=>r.finished_at===null&&r.rolled_back_at===null).length,0);
 const active=legacy.filter(r=>r.finished_at!==null&&r.rolled_back_at===null);
 const coverage=manifest.slice(0,-2).map(m=>{const found=active.filter(r=>r.migration_name===m.name);assert.equal(found.length,1);return {name:m.name,appliedSha256:found[0].checksum};});
 assert.equal(coverage.length,449);assert.equal(stableHash(coverage),input.baseline.apiHistorySha256);
 for(const [row,checksum] of [[prior[0],PRIOR_SHA],...(after?[[added[0],input.migrationSha256]]:[])]){assert.equal(row.checksum,checksum);assert.ok(row.finished_at);assert.equal(row.rolled_back_at,null);assert.equal(row.applied_steps_count,1);}
 return {oldLedgerSha256:stableHash(rows.filter(r=>r.migration_name!==NAME)),apiHistorySha256:stableHash([...coverage,{name:PRIOR_NAME,appliedSha256:PRIOR_SHA}])};
}
export function assertPriorUnchanged(before,after){
 assert.equal(stableHash(after.filter(row=>row.migration_name!==NAME)),stableHash(before));
}
export function checkCatalog(rows,pins){
 assert.deepEqual(rows.map(r=>r.name),CHECKS);
 for(const row of rows){assert.equal(row.validated,true);assert.equal(hash(row.definition),pins[row.name]);}
 return Object.fromEntries(rows.map(r=>[r.name,hash(r.definition)]));
}
export async function readState(client,input,manifest,after){
 await client.query('BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY');
 try{
  await client.query("SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5s'");await client.query("SET LOCAL idle_in_transaction_session_timeout='20s'");
  assert.equal((await client.query('SHOW transaction_read_only')).rows[0].transaction_read_only,'on');
  const ledger=(await client.query(LEDGER_SQL)).rows;
  currentGuard='LEDGER_BASELINE';checkEstablishedLedger(ledger,manifest,input,after);
  currentGuard='CHECKS';
  const checks=checkCatalog((await client.query(CHECK_SQL)).rows,input.checkSha256);
  currentGuard='INDEX';if(!after)assert.equal((await client.query("SELECT to_regclass('public.mail_threads_tenant_connection_id_cover_idx') IS NULL AS absent")).rows[0].absent,true);const index=checkIndex((await client.query(INDEX_SQL)).rows,after);
  if(!after){
   currentGuard='OWNERSHIP';const roles=(await client.query("SELECT relname,pg_has_role(current_user,relowner,'USAGE') AS owner FROM pg_class WHERE oid IN ('public.mail_threads'::regclass,'public._prisma_migrations'::regclass) ORDER BY relname")).rows;
   assert.equal(roles.length,2);assert.ok(roles.every(r=>r.owner===true));
   currentGuard='LOCKS';assert.equal((await client.query(LOCK_SQL)).rows[0].count,0);
  }
  return {ledger,checks,index};
 }finally{await client.query('ROLLBACK');}
}
export function packagedManifest(directory,input){
 const names=readdirSync(directory).filter(n=>existsSync(`${directory}/${n}/migration.sql`)).sort();
 assert.equal(names.length,451);assert.equal(names.at(-1),NAME);
 const manifest=names.map(name=>({name,sha256:hash(readFileSync(`${directory}/${name}/migration.sql`))}));
 assert.equal(hash(JSON.stringify(manifest)),input.manifestSha256);assert.equal(manifest.at(-1).sha256,input.migrationSha256);
 const sql=readFileSync(`${directory}/${NAME}/migration.sql`,'utf8');
 assert.match(sql,/\bBEGIN\s*;/u);assert.match(sql,/SET LOCAL lock_timeout/u);assert.match(sql,/SET LOCAL statement_timeout/u);assert.match(sql,/\bCOMMIT\s*;/u);
 return manifest;
}
const PRISMA_CODES=['P1000','P1001','P1002','P1010','P1011','P1012','P1013','P1017','P3005','P3006','P3008','P3009','P3018'];
const SQL_CODES=['23514','42883','42501','55P03','57014','40P01','40001','42P01','42703'];
export function prismaFailureFacts(run){
 const output=String(run.stdout??'')+String(run.stderr??'');
 const prisma=output.match(/\bP[0-9]{4}\b/u)?.[0]??null;
 const sql=output.match(/\b(?:Error code|SQLSTATE):\s*([A-Z0-9]{5})\b/iu)?.[1]?.toUpperCase()??null;
 return {prismaExitCode:Number.isInteger(run.status)?run.status:null,timedOut:run.error?.code==='ETIMEDOUT',
  prismaCode:PRISMA_CODES.includes(prisma)?prisma:null,sqlState:SQL_CODES.includes(sql)?sql:null,outputSha256:hash(output)};
}
export async function main(){
 let stage='INPUT',client,attempted=false,prismaFailure=null;
 const emit=value=>console.log(PREFIX+JSON.stringify(value));
 try{
  const raw=process.env.MERI_FORWARD451_INPUT;assert.ok(typeof raw==='string'&&Buffer.byteLength(raw)<=6000);
  const input=validateInput(JSON.parse(raw));assert.equal(process.env.GIT_SHA,input.sourceSha);assert.equal(process.env.RELEASE_SHA,input.sourceSha);
  currentGuard='MANIFEST';const manifest=packagedManifest('/app/apps/api/prisma/migrations',input);
  const require=createRequire('/app/apps/api/package.json'),{Client}=require('pg');
  const connectionString=execFileSync(process.execPath,['/app/apps/api/scripts/lib/pe-compose-database-url.js'],{encoding:'utf8',stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']});
  const options={...rdsTlsOptions(connectionString),application_name:'meri-forward451-preflight',connectionTimeoutMillis:15000,query_timeout:10000};
  stage='PREFLIGHT';currentGuard='TLS_CONNECT';client=new Client(options);await client.connect();
  assert.equal(client.connection.stream.encrypted,true);assert.equal(client.connection.stream.authorized,true);
  const before=await readState(client,input,manifest,false);await client.end();client=undefined;
  emit({version:1,kind:'meri-forward451',stage:'PREFLIGHT',status:'VERIFIED',sourceSha:input.sourceSha,ledgerRows:607,activeFinished:507,rolledBack:100,apiSourceMigrations:450,apiHistorySha256:checkEstablishedLedger(before.ledger,manifest,input,false).apiHistorySha256,
   oldLedgerSha256:stableHash(before.ledger),legacyLedgerSha256:input.baseline.fullLedgerSha256,checks:before.checks,index:before.index,tlsVerified:true});
  // Exclusive task-local claim and durable host task intent prevent retries; Prisma owns normal ledger writes.
  writeFileSync('/dev/shm/meri-forward451-once','claimed\n',{flag:'wx',mode:0o600});
  const cert='/dev/shm/meri-forward451-rds-ca.pem';writeFileSync(cert,RDS_CA_PEM,{flag:'wx',mode:0o600});
  const url=new URL(connectionString);url.searchParams.set('sslmode','require');url.searchParams.set('sslaccept','strict');url.searchParams.set('sslcert',cert);
  const env=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(process.env).filter(([k])=>!(/^(DATABASE_URL|DIRECT_URL|PG|PRISMA_MIGRATE|AWS|CLERK|OPENAI|OPENROUTER|ANTHROPIC)/iu.test(k))));
  Object.assign(env,{DATABASE_URL:url.toString(),PRISMA_HIDE_UPDATE_MESSAGE:'1',CHECKPOINT_DISABLE:'1'});
  stage='PRISMA_DEPLOY';currentGuard='PRISMA_DEPLOY';emit({version:1,kind:'meri-forward451',stage,status:'INTENT',sourceSha:input.sourceSha,migrationSha256:input.migrationSha256});
  attempted=true;
  const run=spawnSync(process.execPath,[require.resolve('prisma'),'migrate','deploy','--schema','/app/apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma'],
   {cwd:'/app/apps/api',env,encoding:'utf8',timeout:180000,maxBuffer:2*1024*1024});
  prismaFailure=prismaFailureFacts(run);
  // Never print Prisma stderr/stdout, URL, query or possible parameter values.
  const output=String(run.stdout??'')+String(run.stderr??'');
  assert.equal(run.status,0);assert.equal(run.error,undefined);
  assert.ok(output.includes('All migrations have been successfully applied.'));
  stage='POSTCHECK';currentGuard='TLS_CONNECT';client=new Client(options);await client.connect();
  assert.equal(client.connection.stream.authorized,true);
  const after=await readState(client,input,manifest,true);
  assertPriorUnchanged(before.ledger,after.ledger);
  emit({version:1,kind:'meri-forward451',stage:'COMPLETE',status:'VERIFIED',sourceSha:input.sourceSha,ledgerRows:608,activeFinished:508,rolledBack:100,apiSourceMigrations:451,apiHistorySha256:checkEstablishedLedger(after.ledger,manifest,input,true).apiHistorySha256,
   newMigration:NAME,migrationSha256:input.migrationSha256,manifestSha256:input.manifestSha256,
   oldLedgerSha256:stableHash(before.ledger),oldLedgerUnchanged:true,legacyLedgerSha256:input.baseline.fullLedgerSha256,checks:after.checks,index:after.index,
   prismaExitCode:0,prismaOutputSha256:hash(output),tlsVerified:true});
  return 0;
 }catch(error){
  const code=['23514','42883','42501','55P03','57014','40P01','40001','42P01','42703','P3009','P3018','ETIMEDOUT','ERR_ASSERTION'].includes(error?.code)?error.code:'FORWARD451_REFUSED';
  emit({version:1,kind:'meri-forward451',stage,status:attempted?'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED':'BLOCKED',guard:currentGuard,code,prismaFailure,prismaAttempted:attempted,retryAllowed:false});return 1;
 }finally{await client?.end().catch(()=>{});}
}
if(process.env.MERI_FORWARD451_INPUT!==undefined)process.exitCode=await main();
